lead.headline: IBM's worst day on record as AI eats the IT budget
lead.dek: Down 25%+ on a Q2 warning; customers rotate spend to AI infrastructure while cooler CPI lifts the Nasdaq 1.08%.
body: IBM crashed more than 25% after warning that customers are redirecting budgets toward AI infrastructure. The same session, a cooler June CPI (~+3.5% YoY) lifted the tech-led Nasdaq, and the biggest US banks posted record Q2 profits led by JPMorgan.
lead.whyItMatters: The AI budget shift is no longer a thesis — it's showing up in legacy vendors' guidance.
